routes.name: Queensway Inner Ring
routes.desc: The ring road: south down the surfaced Queensway to Holloway Circus, Smallbrook Queensway past the Bullring, Pershore and Bradford Street, Digbeth and Park Street by Selfridges, out through Eastside and Curzon Circle, then James Watt Queensway, Lancaster Circus and St Chad's back to the Queensway.

routes.name: Aston Expressway Sprint
routes.desc: The A38 all the way: down the Aston Expressway, over the Lancaster Circus flyover, past St Chad's Cathedral along St Chad's and the Queensway, finishing on Suffolk Street Queensway at Holloway Circus.

routes.name: Jewellery Quarter to Bullring
routes.desc: From Vyse Street in the Jewellery Quarter down Frederick and Graham Street, Newhall Street past the BT Tower, Colmore Row past St Philip's, round St Chad's and Lancaster Circus to Corporation Street, The Priory and Moor Street Queensway by Selfridges.

routes.name: Centenary Square Loop
routes.desc: Round Snow Hill and St Chad's Circus, west along Great Charles Street Queensway, Summer Row, Parade and King Edwards Road, Cambridge Street past the Library of Birmingham and the Rep, Lyon and Suffolk Street Queensway down to Holloway Circus, Smallbrook Queensway, Pershore and Bradford Street, Digbeth, out to Curzon Circle, back by Moor Street Queensway, The Priory and Lancaster Circus to Snow Hill.

routes.name: Coventry Road Sprint
routes.desc: From Digbeth by St Martin's out along High Street Deritend and Bordesley to Bordesley Circus, up Coventry Road past St Andrew's and the Green Lane Masjid, down Golden Hillock Road past Ghamkol Sharif and along Small Heath Highway to Asda Small Heath.
